class.description: GameplayResourceEditorInspectorPlugin — Phase 4 Editor Inspector plugin for GameplayResource subclasses (GameplayControlMap, GameplayDifficulty, GameplayPerspective, GameplayAccessibilityOption, GameplayAudioOption, GameplayGraphicsOption, GameplayStyle, GameplayMode). Responsibilities: 1. Embedded Live Preview Header: - GameplayControlMap -> embeds ControlStickDeadzoneVisualizer - GameplayDifficulty -> embeds DifficultyProfileRadar - GameplayPerspective -> embeds PerspectiveFrustumVisualizer - GameplayAccessibilityOption -> embeds AccessibilityLivePreviewCard 2. Collapsible "Synthesized Cascade Rules (collect_rules())" Preview Box: Shows all auto-synthesized and custom GameplayRule declarations emitted by collect_rules() with a [Refresh] button and per-rule [Inspect] buttons. Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
